# TS9502

> **Reserved: not currently emitted by the compiler.** This code is catalogued, but no
> typesugar check reports it yet. If your build fails, look up the code it actually prints.

**Category:** Comptime · **Severity:** Error

## Message

```
comptime() requires exactly 1 argument (a function to evaluate)
```

## Explanation

comptime() evaluates a function at compile time.

Correct:
  comptime(() =&gt; fibonacci(10))

Incorrect:
  comptime(fibonacci, 10)  // Too many args
  comptime()               // Missing arg
